description: Unified diff between two texts. Pure: nothing is read from disk. Use it to show what an edit will do before writing it, or to explain what a write did.

after.description: The text as it will be.

context_lines.description: Unchanged lines kept around each hunk (`-U` of `git diff`). Defaults to the worker's `diff_context_lines`.

path.description: Path used to label the patch header. Nothing is read from disk — this is presentation only.

Hunk.description: One `@@` block: the line ranges it covers on each side, plus the counts a gutter needs without re-reading the patch body.

new_lines.description: Number of "after" lines the hunk spans.

new_start.description: First line of the hunk on the "after" side, 1-based.

old_lines.description: Number of "before" lines the hunk spans.

old_start.description: First line of the hunk on the "before" side, 1-based. `0` when the before side is empty (pure addition), matching unified-diff convention.

response_schema.description: A rendered patch plus the structured view of the same edits.

added.description: Total lines added across every hunk.

hunks.description: One entry per `@@` block, in file order.

patch.description: Unified diff. Empty when the two sides are identical.

removed.description: Total lines removed across every hunk.

truncated.description: True when either side exceeded `max_bytes` and the diff was skipped. `patch` and `hunks` are empty in that case — a caller that ignores this flag would read "no changes" from a file that was simply too big.

response_schema.title: DiffResult
